entities.name: Holy Trinity Church, Tobolsk
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Holy Trinity Church is a Catholic church in the city of Tobolsk, Russia. The church is part of Diocese of Novosibirsk. It is a protected historical monument of Gothic architecture. The church also offers public organ concerts.
